time_basis: Synchronized smartphone elapsed_s from the validated S-S1 stream
selection_method: Deterministic windows selected from measured VBOX reference speed, yaw-rate, and longitudinal-acceleration summaries; labels describe signal behavior, not inferred road semantics.

field_policy.classification_note: GPS orientation is GNSS-derived and hidden. Azimuth, pitch, and roll are the separately documented Android phone-orientation sensor outputs and remain available. VBOX fields are evaluation-only.

scenarios.selection_evidence: Low speed variation and low accumulated absolute yaw rotation in the measured reference window.
Large accumulated absolute yaw rotation in the measured reference window.
More than half the measured reference samples are below 3 km/h, followed by higher-speed motion.
Sustained higher measured reference speed with no samples below 3 km/h.
Non-standard duration demonstration with speed, turning, stopping, and longitudinal-acceleration variation.
